item.tib: mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig sde lnga las sgrub gzhung bdud rtsi'i bum bzang
item.coloph: ces pa 'di yang dus mtha'i kho bo 'gru btsun bdag gis chu glang zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu drug gi nyin nyi ma rtse shar dang dus mnyam mdo smad sa gnas rin chen spungs pa 'am lung grags kyi brag dkar yang rtse g.yung drung shel phug gi mdun gter sgrom shel gyi pha wang nas dngos grub rnyed de/ phyis shing stag lo'i zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bzhi rgyal phur 'grub sbyor nyin lung zin grogs kyis bskul ba dang / lo gcig gi gsang rgya yol nas thar bde smin grol gling du brda ris bod yig tu phab pa rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
